isolatedAttackQueries.command: taskset -c 7 cargo test --release -p haitaka --features washogi benchmark_old_and_direct_attack_queries -- --ignored --nocapture
isolatedAttackQueries.method: Same fixed-seed legal positions for old/direct, both colors, black_box; 3 alternating old/direct batches, each >=1 second. Washogi walk terminates at 77 positions; Heian Dai at 128. Diagnostic query distribution differs from perft candidates.

reason: 2.35x Washogi and 2.05x Heian Dai perft, above +10% adoption goal; identical oracle and leaf counts, no >5% control regression.
remaining: Original 2.8-3.6x / 2.5-3.1x perft projections were optimistic: isolated attack queries improved 3.30x / 3.18x rather than assumed 5-10x. Different query distribution prevents exact Amdahl attribution.
No reverse lookup table or board-copy/hash/effect/path optimization added; retain these for separate measured stages.
All-32-rule regression and frontend browser deployment remain stage 5.
